svg.aria-label: Hybrid Fuzzy Logic Recommender. Research · Python · PyTorch · Pandas · scikit-fuzzy. Apr 2026. Explainable product recommendations: a 74-rule Mamdani fuzzy engine re-ranks item-CF candidates from Amazon review data, so every result traces back to readable if-then rules.
